items.title: "It's a major step forward in stem separation technology": Zplane's Peel Stems 2 nearly halves the latency of its real-time stem separation plugin
items.excerpt: zplane's Peel Stems 2 cuts real-time stem-separation latency from 483ms to 245ms at 44.1kHz, letting producers split a mix into drums, bass, vocals and 'other' and rebalance elements live inside their DAW. A concrete AI-audio craft upgrade for remixing, sampling and live workflows.

items.title: Techivation release M-Compressor 2
items.excerpt: Techivation's M-Compressor 2 adds an intelligent Mix Assistant that analyses incoming audio and generates 12 tailored compression settings, collapsing the plugin's controls into a single blendable macro. An AI-assist angle on the everyday mixing chore of dialling in compression.

items.title: Pixelsncodes releases Lumen, a FREE open-source Windows synth that turns images into sound
items.excerpt: Lumen is a free, open-source Windows synth built with the Claude AI coding agent whose image-to-wavetable engine reads an image's bytes and turns them into a playable wavetable. A grassroots example of AI-vibe-coded instruments and cross-modal sound design entering the plugin space.

items.title: Suno explores developer API, seeking apps 'that unlock experiences generative music makes possible for the first time'
items.excerpt: Suno CPO Jack Brody says the AI-music company is exploring a developer API, starting with a curated set of partners, to let apps build new interactive experiences on top of generative music. A platform-capability shift that could reshape how creative tools embed AI song generation.

items.title: Steinberg SpectraLayers 13 now available
items.excerpt: SpectraLayers 13 extends its AI neural-network spectral editing with Unmix Sound Effects, Unmix Two Voices, Voice DeCrosstalk and a new Reconstruct resynthesis module, targeting creative unmixing and audio repair. Broadens the AI stem/spectral toolkit for producers and post-production.
